scraped.title: TVET in the Palestinian Territories
scraped.subtitle: Pre-Feasibility and Feasibility Study for TVET in the Palestinian Territories
scraped.financing: Bundesministerium für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (BMZ)
scraped.description: Sustainable economic development, employment promotion and education including technical and vocational education and training (TVET) is one of the focal areas of German – Palestinian bilateral Development Cooperation (DC).
body: Sustainable economic development, employment promotion and education including technical and vocational education and training (TVET) is one of the focal areas of German – Palestinian bilateral Development Cooperation (DC).
Both sides consider TVET a key pillar for the promotion of employment and the strengthening of the Palestinian economy and intend to intensify their cooperation in this field.

Through these two studies ICON provides support to the Palestinian and German stakeholders in their joint efforts to identify and design future projects/ programs for German Financial Cooperation (FC) in the Palestinian TVET sector as an integral part of economic development.
